name.description: Credential title — e.g. 'AWS Certified Solutions Architect'

type.description: Kind of credential, following the Open Badges 3.0 achievementType vocabulary. Exam-backed credentials ('certification', 'license') render under Certifications; completion records ('course', 'micro-credential') render under Professional Development. Omitted means 'certification'.

expiry_date.description: Expiry date, if the credential expires — YYYY or YYYY-MM. No JSON Resume equivalent; dropped on export.

identifier.description: Credential/licence ID. No JSON Resume equivalent; dropped on export.
